lenses.label: Optical composite · NOIRLab + Niittee
lenses.title: Pleiades optical cloud with wider image coverage
lenses.description: Relative display colors on an authored finite depth surface. Dust layering, scattering, extinction and individual stellar depths are not recovered; fine filaments and bright-star halos remain imperfect. This lens fuses Niittee's wide optical color with central NOIRLab luminance detail; its reference preview shows Niittee's original photograph before fusion. Surrounding optical stars use Gaia positions and parallax-informed distances; their brightness/color display is independent of this spectral image.
